constant_arm.label: constant_3e-5
constant_arm.note: Scientific pairing uses this run as the constant arm only after parent verifies its frozen config equals treatment except LR; disclose as post-launch control.

linear_arm.label: linear_3e-5_to_1e-5
linear_arm.lr_applied_per_update_convention: to_be_fixed_by_parent_before_launch; default proposal: set LR for cum update c=373..432 before that update's optimizer step

shared.restore: model weights, Adam state (exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, step), torch/numpy/env RNG state restored first; then LR for next update computed from saved schedule progress
shared.realized_optimizer_steps: may differ between arms because target-KL early stop is a treatment outcome; record, do not force

endpoint.checkpoint_selection: none; final state at update 384 only

scientific_primary.policy: deterministic argmax, same as existing dev_eval protocol
scientific_primary.primary_metric: mean alive raw frames over 64 independent episodes
scientific_primary.pairing: per-seed difference linear_minus_constant on identical episode seeds

secondary.note: Already used for selection of update 324; not an independent endpoint

operational_best_retention.note: Best-checkpoint retention decision made on dev seeds is operational and does not alter the scientific comparison

decision_rules.unit_of_inference: one training pair (one master seed) times 64 independent eval seeds; uncertainty from training replicate is NOT estimated by this study
decision_rules.primary_claim_allowed: linear decay vs constant 3e-5 paired result for seed 4200000001 at update 384 on the frozen held-out pool
decision_rules.mean_lr_confound: linear mean LR is 2e-5; a win does not isolate schedule shape from lower average LR
decision_rules.followup_constant_2e-5: not in first budget; only if decay wins on primary metric, with separate registration

invalid_if: parent hash or checkpoint hash mismatch
restored Adam or RNG state not matching saved hashes
schedule origin, horizon, or completed_schedule_updates mismatch
any non-finite loss, gradient, or LR
per-group LR log missing or differing from LR(cum) formula
held-out eval incomplete, not 64 episodes, or seed order changed
work or total wall budget exceeded
not_invalid: early target-KL stop changing realized epochs or optimizer steps (record as outcome)

training_window_each.device: MPS one at a time or CPU

eval_window_each.device: CPU or one MPS run at a time after current training terminal lease cleared
eval_window_each.estimate: unmeasured in this design; parent must set from a registered timing or the protocol reserve formula
